Input.Content: A warehouse compared two packing layouts. Layout P had 12 damaged parcels in 200 shipments; layout Q had 7 in 200. The two weeks used different parcel-size mixes. The report does not isolate the layout effect. During a separate check with the same layout, damaged-parcel counts also differed across parcel-size mixes. Staff training hours were not recorded.

Idea.Title: The lower recorded damage count under layout Q does not establish a causal layout benefit.
Idea.Description: The lower recorded damage count under layout Q does not establish a causal layout benefit.
Idea.Rationale: Preserve the reported result and its evidence limits.
